captions.caption: A man sits in a forest filled with bare trees and fallen leaves.
The man remains seated in the forest while rhythmic tapping sounds.
The man sits among the thin trees in the leaf-covered woods.
A wide shot shows the man sitting in the middle of a sparse forest.
The man is seen in the distance sitting in a woodland area.
The man continues to sit among the trees in the forest.
The man is shown sitting in the forest during the day.
Close-up of hands sharpening a small knife on a leather strop.
Hands move the knife blade across the surface of the strop.
The knife is repeatedly drawn across the leather sharpening tool.
Hands continue the process of stropping the knife blade.
A close-up view shows the knife being sharpened with precise movements.
The man sharpens the knife blade on the wooden-handled strop.
Hands finish the stropping motion on the leather sharpener.
A wooden cup with steaming liquid sits next to carving tools on a cloth.
Steam rises from a wooden cup placed on a canvas bag.
The steaming cup and carving tools are shown on a canvas surface.
A hand reaches into the frame to pick up a small wooden tool.
The hand picks up a wooden shuttle tool from the canvas bag.
A hand selects a wooden tool from several lying on the cloth.
The hand lifts the wooden shuttle tool away from the ground.
The hand removes the tool from the collection on the bag.
A man carves wood in the background while meat roasts over a fire.
Meat roasts on a spit over a campfire with a man in the background.
The man carves wood behind a spit-roasting bird and a black kettle.
A blurred view of the man carving wood with the campfire in focus.
The man continues carving in the background behind the roasting meat.
A soft-focus shot shows the man working on a piece of wood.
The man carves wood in the background of the campsite.
The man continues his carving work behind the open fire.
Close-up of hands using a knife to carve a rectangular wood piece.
Hands carve a groove into the center of the wooden board.
The man uses a knife to carefully remove wood from the piece.
Hands hold the wood steady while carving into the surface.
The man pauses to inspect the progress of his wood carving.
The man holds a wooden shuttle tool against the board he is carving.
The man compares the size of the shuttle to the carved area.
Hands hold both the wooden board and the shuttle tool.
The man checks the fit of the shuttle on the wooden piece.
Hands manipulate the wood and the tool to check the carving.
Close-up of hands using a knife to scrape a hole in the wood.
The knife tip is used to bore a small hole into the wooden board.
Hands twist the knife into the wood to create a circular opening.
The man uses the knife blade to drill into the wooden piece.
The man inspects the small hole he has just carved in the wood.
The man begins to carve a second hole in the wooden board.
Hands use a knife to carefully carve another hole into the wood.
The man continues to enlarge the hole using the knife tip.
Hands scrape the surface of the wood with the knife blade.
The man refines the edges of the hole in the wooden board.
Hands work on the wooden piece with a small carving knife.
The man continues to carve details into the piece of wood.
Close-up of hands carving thin shavings from the edge of the wood.
The knife removes a thin strip of wood from the side of the board.
Hands carefully carve a notch into the side of the wooden piece.
The man uses the knife to shape the edge of the wood.
The knife carves a thin shaving from the wooden board's edge.
Hands continue to refine the shape of the wooden piece.
The man carves a small groove into the edge of the wood.
Hands use the knife to finish carving a detail on the wood piece.
